title: Template Customization Question Readiness reads a release and judges each rule: golden templates pass, a missing declaration fails, the table stays readable
steps: S1: Run node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/template-customization-question-readiness-runner.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/template-customization-question-readiness-c.test.mjs from the repository root.

S2: The runner tests build gallery card tags, the asset cache and the Markdown result table from fixtures; the c tests run the ABOUT rules on the golden templates' declarations and on a contract missing a demo company name.
expect: S1: every named test reports ok.

S2: the golden three pass ABOUT-3 on their declared demoCompanyNames; a demo name the declared list misses fails, and so does a contract declaring none; a tag that is not a release tag never reaches gh; a cell never breaks the table.
evidence: Spec tasks/spec-template-customization-question-readiness.md and ADR 0029 (#1013): 29 rules a template must meet after Customize your site; result on 38 templates in tasks/bang-chung/template-customization-question-readiness/.
fence: The rule registry and readers of the readiness check, and the runner that turns reports into the result table.

tests: the tag of a gallery card is the release tag templateCards wrote, local packs left out
a tag that is not a release tag never reaches gh
the table has a column per rule id the reports carry, a later rule included
a cell never breaks the Markdown table
ABOUT-3: the golden three pass on their declared demoCompanyNames
ABOUT-3: a demo name the declared list misses fails, and so does a contract declaring none
